## Days with Atrial Fibrillation Episodes in March
- In March, you recorded at least one atrial fibrillation episode on **12 days**.

## Advice to Improve Sleep Quality and Reduce Atrial Fibrillation Episodes
1. Maintain a consistent sleep schedule by going to bed at 11:30 PM and waking up at the same time daily.
2. Break up sedentary periods with short active breaks to reduce nighttime restlessness.
3. Continue the morning walk to support your circadian rhythm; consider adding a short evening walk to aid relaxation.
4. Avoid heavy meals within 2-3 hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disruption.
5. Establish a calming pre-bedtime routine such as reading or meditation to lower stress.
6. Limit caffeine and stimulants in the afternoon and evening to minimize sleep fragmentation.
7. Optimize your sleep environment by keeping the room cool, dark, and quiet.
